patthana15.64:1.1: Rūpāvacaraṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca narūpāvacaro nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Narūpāvacaraṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca narūpāvacaro nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā dve.
patthana15.64:2.1: Narūpāvacaraṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca narūpāvacaro naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ. (Abyākatamūlaṃ dve.)
